title: Normalize polite prefixes for workspace create-file commands
goal: Make polite Vietnamese and common English workspace file-creation requests execute through the existing verified create-file Skill without weakening path or output verification.
context: The canonical Skill selector recognizes polite commands such as “Hãy tạo file workspace/notes.md với nội dung: …”, but parseCreateFileRequest only accepts commands beginning directly with “tạo file”, “tạo tệp”, “create file”, or “write file”. The selected Skill therefore rejects the unchanged polite lead-in at execution time.
forbidden_changes: Do not weaken workspace-root, traversal, symlink, protected-file, or size validation.
Do not change executor identity binding, policy/approval, or output verification.
Do not alter general chat input, unrelated Skill parsing, or UI.
acceptance_criteria: Only known polite command prefixes are removed at the create-file parser boundary.
A polite Vietnamese request creates a real workspace file with exact requested contents and verified=true.
Existing direct create-file commands and content delimiters continue to work.
Unsafe paths and invalid output remain fail-closed.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Revert the single squashed task commit if command parsing changes valid file paths or content boundaries; retain all existing path and verification guards.
